title: Closing the EFC Consciousness Bridge: Dimensionless, Scale-Invariant Unification of Entropy, Dynamics, and Awareness
description: Introduces a dimensionless, regime-indexed mapping from the EFC entropy field S to cognitive variables (Omega-hat, kappa-hat), derives coupled dynamical equations that make the Omega–kappa anti-correlation intrinsic, and replaces the separable product C=Omega*kappa with a single-parameter non-separable functional. The framework closes the cosmology-to-cognition bridge, inherits a cross-domain constant K=4.4±0.6 from SPARC rotation curves, and shows qualitative consistency with propofol sedation EEG.
author: Morten Magnusson

Omega_hat_def.description: Dimensionless spectral differentiation derived from the EFC entropy field S normalized by the regime-specific characteristic entropy S_\ell; reduces to H(p)/H_max at L3.

kappa_hat_def.description: Dimensionless causal integration proportional to the gradient of the functional derivative of entropy density; reduces to mean transfer entropy at L3 under the identification in EFC-C.

eq_I.description: Dynamics of spectral differentiation: entropic drift driven by the same functional derivative that appears in the EFC field equation, stabilized by diffusion.

eq_II.description: Dynamics of causal integration: energy-flow source opposed by a damping term coupling to differentiation, yielding an intrinsic anti-correlation.

eq_III.description: Non-separable consciousness functional with a single free coupling constant \gamma; quadratic at low \hat{\Omega}\hat{\kappa}, saturating to the product at high values.

bridge_B1_star.description: Inherited cross-domain relation linking integration to network connectivity and correlation time, with K derived from SPARC galactic rotation curves (no neural parameter fitting).

steady_state_anti_corr.description: Steady-state anti-correlation between integration and differentiation emerges directly from Eq. II.

key_results.main_finding: A closed, dimensionless EFC-to-cognition bridge yields an intrinsic Omega–kappa anti-correlation and a one-parameter non-separable consciousness functional, qualitatively consistent with propofol EEG while inheriting K=4.4±0.6 from SPARC.
datasets_used: SPARC galactic rotation curve data (for K)
Chennu et al. 2016 propofol sedation EEG (N=20, overlap n=12)

sealed_predictions.statement: In unequivocally conscious states, corr(\hat{\Omega}, \hat{\kappa}) is negative across time or regions, arising from \hat{\kappa}_{ss} \propto 1/\hat{\Omega}.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Simultaneous estimation of \hat{\Omega} (spectral entropy fraction) and \hat{\kappa} (mean transfer entropy) from EEG/MEG/ECoG with robust confound controls, testing correlation sign and 1/\hat{\Omega} scaling.

sealed_predictions.statement: The consciousness functional exhibits low-regime quadratic scaling C \approx \gamma \, \hat{\Omega}^2 \hat{\kappa}^2 and saturates to C \to \hat{\Omega}\hat{\kappa} at high \hat{\Omega}\hat{\kappa}, with a single \gamma across tasks within a regime.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: State- or task-sweeps (e.g., graded anesthesia or cognitive load) mapping C vs. \hat{\Omega}\hat{\kappa} and fitting a single \gamma; failure to capture both quadratic and saturation regimes invalidates the functional.

sealed_predictions.statement: Under approximately fixed energy-flow source J_flow, steady-state \hat{\kappa} scales as 1/\hat{\Omega} across conditions.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Parametric manipulation of spectral differentiation (e.g., propofol titration) while estimating transfer entropy; regression of \hat{\kappa} against 1/\hat{\Omega} should yield linearity with slope J_flow/\mu.

kill_criteria: KC1: Robustly positive corr(\hat{\Omega}, \hat{\kappa}) in confirmed conscious wakefulness after controlling for confounds (contradicts Eq. II steady-state anti-correlation).
KC2: Observed C increases monotonically with \hat{\Omega} without concurrent suppression of \hat{\kappa} (no trade-off), violating the damping term −\mu \hat{\kappa} \hat{\Omega}.
KC3: Spatial or temporal gradients of \delta S/\delta \rho at L3 (operationalized via cortical entropy gradients) show no association with \hat{\Omega} or awareness changes.
KC4: A single \gamma cannot fit C vs. \hat{\Omega}\hat{\kappa} across multiple L3 datasets/tasks within statistical tolerance, requiring dataset-specific \gamma values.
KC5: The cross-domain relation \hat{\kappa}_{healthy} = K/(1 + \lambda_2(W)\,\tau_c) fails across healthy cohorts or reanalysis invalidates K \approx 4.4 \pm 0.6 derived from SPARC.

related_packages.role: Prior EFC-C analysis with propofol EEG re-analysis referenced for qualitative consistency

type: structural derivation, cross-domain bridge, framework extension

target.system: Cross-domain bridge: cosmological entropy S to cognitive variables (Omega_hat, kappa_hat)
target.scale: All EFC regimes (L0 cosmology to L3 cognition/AI)

three_equation_system.eq_I: d Omega_hat / dt = -lambda_Omega * grad(delta S / delta rho) + D_Omega * Laplacian(Omega_hat)
three_equation_system.eq_II: d kappa_hat / dt = J_flow - mu * kappa_hat * Omega_hat
three_equation_system.eq_III: C = Omega_hat * kappa_hat * (1 - exp(-gamma * Omega_hat * kappa_hat))

dimensionless_variables.reduces_to_cognitive: Omega_hat -> Omega = H(p)/H_max when S(rho) = H(p) and S_l = H_max at L3
dimensionless_variables.reduces_to_transfer_entropy: kappa_hat -> kappa = <T(X->Y)> when functional derivative identified with mean transfer entropy

cross_domain_constant.source: SPARC galactic rotation curve data (B1* bridge equation from EFC-C v2)

non_separable_functional.form: C = Omega_hat * kappa_hat * (1 - exp(-gamma * Omega_hat * kappa_hat))
non_separable_functional.low_limit: C ~ gamma * Omega_hat^2 * kappa_hat^2 (both differentiation and integration required)
non_separable_functional.high_limit: C -> Omega_hat * kappa_hat (recovers product in saturation)
non_separable_functional.why_non_separable: exp(-gamma * Omega_hat * kappa_hat) couples Omega_hat and kappa_hat multiplicatively inside the exponent

emergent_anti_correlation.previously: External constraint corr(Omega, kappa) < 0 imposed axiomatically
emergent_anti_correlation.now: Anti-correlation derived from dynamics (Eq. II steady state)

propofol_consistency.dataset: Chennu et al. 2016 propofol sedation EEG (N=20, overlap n=12)
propofol_consistency.status: Qualitative consistency, not a direct test of full model

kill_conditions: corr(Omega_hat, kappa_hat) > 0 in confirmed conscious states
C increases monotonically with Omega_hat without kappa_hat-suppression
Cortical entropy gradient shows no correlation with consciousness level across anaesthesia depths
Cross-domain constant K inconsistent between galactic and neural data at > 3 sigma
limitations: Regime characteristic scales (rho_l, S_l) must be calibrated empirically for biological/cognitive systems
Identification delta S / delta rho <-> transfer entropy in cognitive regime is an ansatz, not a derivation
gamma is currently unconstrained; its value must come from EEG/fMRI data across conscious states
Diffusion term D_Omega * Laplacian(Omega_hat) assumes continuum approximation that may break down in discrete network topologies
next_steps: Estimate gamma from existing open datasets (PCI database or Human Connectome Project resting-state)
If gamma fixed from one dataset, model becomes fully predictive for all others
Compute grad(delta S / delta rho) from high-density EEG or source-reconstructed MEG
Test correlation between gradient magnitude and C across states (waking, sleep, anaesthesia, psychedelics)
